## Critique
- claim-1: Valid only at abstract level. It does not identify the theorem, hypotheses, coefficient ring, relevant generating families, or any indecomposables quotient, so it does not satisfy the requested source-refresh certificate.
- claim-2: Correct audit of the supplied evidence. Without exact primary full-text passages, theorem-level applicability cannot be independently reviewed.
- claim-3: The supplied abstract indeed contains no indecomposables assertion. This establishes only evidentiary silence: it neither proves nor disproves \(J_{v_{r,s,t,n}}/\Lambda_+J_{v_{r,s,t,n}}\cong\mathbb Z^{\binom{a+b}{a}}\).

**Requested target established: no.** No bounded exact full-text passage or stable theorem/hypothesis locator was obtained. Consequently, neither the precise minimality theorem nor the stronger indecomposables statement has been established from the 2024 paper.

## Repair certificates
- [source-refresh] Retrieve from arXiv `2209.02011v2` or the DOI full text bounded verbatim passages containing: (i) the numbered minimality theorem and all hypotheses; (ii) definitions identifying its coefficient ring, ideal, parameters, and generating families with the 2011 conjecture; and (iii) every theorem/proposition mentioning \(J/\Lambda_+J\), indecomposables, rank, freeness, or torsion. Record stable section/theorem and page or line locators, then compare the conclusions line-by-line with [source-2@L1495-L1502|claim=formal-document] and [source-2@L1536-L1552|claim=formal-document].

## Required revisions
- Do not present “We prove the minimality conjecture” as theorem-level grounding.
- After source refresh, state separately whether the paper proves minimality of the two specified families and whether it proves the stronger integral free-abelian quotient statement. If the latter is absent, mark it unresolved rather than deriving it from minimality alone.
